scope: CRM Admin AI summary privacy and model-gateway fix
rootCause: OCR-created privacy tokens were not persisted before CRM summary generation.
V2 Docker runtime did not provide an explicit summary model dependency, so the Admin route could fall into deterministic formatting and fail on unknown tokens.
changes: Persist OCR-created session token maps before document completion and external sync.
Use metadata-only document summaries for CRM/Salesforce descriptions.
Rebuild Admin AI summary input from current masked conversation and document metadata so legacy OCR summaries cannot reintroduce stale tokens.
Add authenticated bounded Python /internal/v1/model/summarize contract and Node adapter.
Return typed summary errors instead of generic INTERNAL_ERROR.
